purpose: Test whether P0678's broad radial missing-deflection pattern repeats across six already-spent CLASH clusters by comparing training-only compact-halo deflection vectors with independently reconstructed baryonic radial deflections, without numerical derivatives, a new gravity-law fit, or a raw image-root score.

parameter_selection.fit_scope: training images only when a within-family holdout exists; all images for descriptive RXJ1347
parameter_selection.external_shear_role: reported separately and never included in the primary halo-to-baryon amplitude ratio

sampling.annulus_per_system: minimum through maximum observed multiple-image radius about the frozen baryonic center

baryonic_predictors_only: log10 baryonic acceleration at annulus pivot
log10 baryonic enclosed-mass proxy at annulus pivot
log10 baryonic reduced deflection at annulus pivot
predictor_analysis.descriptive_primary_systems: all systems whose compact-halo parameters are not at an optimization boundary
predictor_analysis.reliable_subset: non-boundary systems with all training roots converged and compact-halo heldout radial RMS <= 5 arcsec
predictor_analysis.regression: one-predictor log-linear least squares with leave-one-system-out prediction
predictor_analysis.small_sample_warning: fewer than four reliable systems forbids selection of a predictor law

selection_rule: P0682 may advance only a qualitative radial morphology or a provisional baryonic predictor class. It cannot advance a numerical gravity law. A constant amplitude is provisionally interesting only if its frozen scatter gate passes. A predictor is provisionally interesting only if its correlation, leave-one-out improvement, and minimum reliable-system gates all pass. Compact-halo target quantities can be outputs but never candidate inputs.
claim_boundary: All six clusters and their compact-halo fits are spent development data; this atlas cannot validate a new law.
The fitted NIE halo is a low-parameter comparator field, not a unique dark-matter map or a measured physical field.
RXJ1347 is a descriptive stress case because multiple halo parameters are at optimization bounds and it has no within-family holdout.
MACS0329 and MACS1115 have weak compact-halo predictive diagnostics and must not dominate a predictor claim.
With at most six systems, all correlations and regressions are hypothesis-generating.
P0633 galaxy kinematics and P0640 additional-cluster outcomes remain sealed.
